case1.description: Samsung A53 SM-S536DL, Android 14. Hexordia, Magnet Virtual Summit CTF 2026. Validated against com.google.android.videos/purchase_store.db: two Google accounts appear in user_data (danieljonesonline55@gmail.com, djones.iss.secure@gmail.com) but only the second has a matching user_configuration row, confirmed by comparing both tables directly, so this fixture exercises both 'Play Config Synced' states in one file. purchased_assets, search_history, wishlist and watch_next_feed were confirmed empty in the source extraction, so no purchase or watch history is lost by trimming. The database is mirrored at three real filesystem paths in this extraction (/data/data, /data/user/0, /data_mirror/data_ce/null/0); file_count reflects all three copies of the db/-wal/-shm set.

case2.description: Google Pixel 7a, Android 14. Josh Hickman, public images.
